appliesWhen.semanticAnchor: bulk multi-row writes and multi-statement transactions using SQL Server table-valued parameters (AddSqlTableValuedParameter, MapToSqlTableValuedParameterAttribute) or PostgreSQL binary COPY (CopyMapper) inside SqlBatch, PgBatch, or ShardSetBatch

fields.body: For multi-row writes on SQL Server, prefer `AddSqlTableValuedParameter` or `[MapToSqlTableValuedParameter]` over multi-step batches. Passing `null` or an empty collection sends `Value = null`, which SQL Server observes as an empty table-valued parameter; however, callers passing a custom unbuffered lazy `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` (not implementing `ICollection<SqlDataRecord>` or `IReadOnlyCollection<SqlDataRecord>`) must ensure the sequence yields at least one record or pass `null`, because `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` rejects an empty unbuffered enumerator at execution time. On PostgreSQL, combine `CopyMapper` binary `COPY` into a staging table with a follow-up `BatchStep` inside a `PgBatch` or `ShardBatch` so the bulk load and consuming SQL execute atomically in one transaction.
fields.title: Bulk and multi-statement write idioms for SQL Server TVPs and PostgreSQL COPY
